# Emit Embeddings

This feature processes and emits embeddings for entities in a specified repository. It skips unchanged entities to optimize performance, ensures that failed embeddings are marked as pending, and provides progress updates during emission.

- `knowledge_compiler/retrieval/embed.py` — `knowledge_compiler.retrieval.embed.emit_embeddings`
